entities.name: Magnetic Mountain
entities.description: A lodestone mountain north of Sukurvia on Jamuura whose magnetism pulls in iron and steel from far away.

entities.name: Robaran Mercenaries
entities.description: Mercenaries who stole one of Johan's airships and crashed it at the mountain.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Owner of an airship stolen in Tirras.

entities.name: Badger

entities.name: Heath

events.summary: The Robaran Mercenaries stole one of Johan's airships in Tirras and flew northeast.
events.quote: After stealing one of Johan 's airships in Tirras

events.summary: The airship was pulled from the sky by the mountain and crashed; Badger, Echo and Paxton died and Heath was badly injured and left behind.
events.quote: the airship was pulled from the sky to crash catastrophically
